title: WTB Introduces New Byway RS, Course, and Macro Aero Gravel Tires
content:
WTB’s new family of high-volume gravel tires pair wide tire profiles and efficient treads with patent-pending aerodynamic technology. Engineered to roll fast, maintain predictable grip across diverse terrain, and conserve rider energy at speed, the new line represents a major leap forward in gravel tire performance.

Meet The Family

  • Byway RS 50 (620g): The pure speed option in the collection. A slick centerline with low-profile transition and shoulder knobs delivers exceptional rolling efficiency on hardpack gravel, pavement and race courses, while retaining predictable cornering traction when conditions get loose.
  • Course 52 (635g): The sweet spot between outright speed and all-terrain capability. Its versatile tread pattern delivers dependable traction without sacrificing rolling efficiency, making it the ideal choice for varied gravel conditions.
  • Macro 54 (640g) Engineered for rougher terrain and bigger adventures. As the highest-volume tire in the family, it pairs a more aggressive tread with taller, wider-spaced knobs for maximum confidence on loose, rocky, and technical surfaces.

Grip and Protection as Standard

The design brief for the Byway RS, Course, and Macro was simple: build the fastest gravel tires possible. Achieving that required optimizing ride quality, balanced traction, low rolling resistance, and dependable flat protection with groundbreaking aerodynamic engineering as the ultimate performance multiplier.

To bring aerodynamic expertise to the project, WTB partnered with Stromm, creators of the world’s fastest UCI-legal road bike. The result is a collection of high-volume tires that deliver the confident handling required to maintain momentum while significantly reducing aerodynamic drag.

Wider Profiles. Premium Construction

The new gravel collection is engineered to perform seamlessly across modern wide gravel rims (25mm to 32mm internal), with the tread and sidewall profiles specifically optimized around a 28 mm internal width. This versatile casing profile provides exceptional support, predictable cornering stability at lower pressures, and preserves the ideal aerodynamic surface.

These are not the WTB materials you are used to. WTB has completely overhauled its tire construction from the ground up, implementing new manufacturing methods, ultra-consistent production tolerances, and advanced material sourcing to establish a new benchmark for WTB casing suppleness and compound performance.

Each model features a refined 120 TPI casing with complete bead-to-bead SG2 puncture defense for maximum flat protection without added stiffness. Traction is powered by an upgraded Dual DNA rubber compound, combining refined, low-drag center rubber for high speeds with supple, high-friction shoulder lugs for confident cornering.

The Aero Detail

All three tires feature strategically placed vortex generators and trip strips incorporated into the sidewalls. These features manipulate airflow over the tire and wheel system, controlling boundary layer separation and reducing the low-pressure wake that typically increases drag and slows you down.

As speed increases, so do the efficiency gains. Stromm validated the patent-pending design through rigorous field (Chung) testing, comparing the aero casing against an identical control tire without aerodynamic features under real-world conditions.

Testing at the Jerry Baker Memorial Velodrome in Redmond, WA, Stromm’s Chief Aerodynamicist Ben Rothacker confirmed impressive drag reductions at typical gravel speeds:

  • 5.8 watts at 30 km/h (18.6 mph)
  • 9.3 watts at 35 km/h (21.7 mph)
  • 13.8 watts at 40 km/h (24.8 mph)

“Stromm applied the same real-world applicable engineering that made the fastest road bike to this tire, designing in surface features that substantially improve aero over the tire/wheel even when dirty and with no compromise to the tread. We brought all our tools to bear, running what may be the largest CFD simulations in the cycling industry to date and then doing detailed CdA measurements of clean and dirty tires with and without surface treatments to make sure what we found on the computer is working on every ride. ” – Ben Rothacker

Availability

The WTB Byway RS, Course, and Macro are available with a choice of black or tan sidewalls, carry an MSRP of $89.95 / €79.95, and are available through WTB dealers and distributors worldwide and at wtb.com

WTB’s new CGR carbon gravel wheels shown in the pictures will also be arriving soon to create the ultimate high-speed gravel wheel and tire system.

Find all the new tires and rims at Wilderness Trail Bikes.
